base = '52c13f9a3da4a6504ccc7afb423d63ba4dc3eb18'
digest = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
old = lambda p: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':' + str(p)])
assert os.getuid() == os.geteuid() == 1002
allowed = [q/'root_fixture_plan.py', q/'test_root_fixture_isolation.py',
           q/'evidence/pins.json', q/'evidence/root-fixture-r6.json',

changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', base]).decode().splitlines()
assert set(changed) <= {str(p) for p in allowed}
historical = json.loads((q/'evidence/root-fixture-r5.json').read_text())['closure']
landed = json.loads((root/'resume-context/owner-root-fixture-r5/parser-landed.json').read_text())['paths']

assert landed_hashes == historical['unchanged_landed_sha256']
pins = json.loads((q/'evidence/pins.json').read_text())

updated = {'root_plan_sha256': q/'root_fixture_plan.py',
           'root_fixture_test_sha256': q/'test_root_fixture_isolation.py',
           'root_coordinator_sha256': root/'root_resume_fixture_coordinator.py'}
assert {k:v for k,v in pins.items() if k not in updated} == {
    k:v for k,v in previous_pins.items() if k not in updated}
for kind, directory, key in [('baseline', q/'evidence/baseline-source', 'baseline_manifest_sha256'),
                             ('candidate', q, 'candidate_manifest_sha256')]:
    manifest = directory/'approved-scripts.json'
    assert digest(manifest.read_bytes()) == pins[key]
    assert json.loads(manifest.read_text()) == pins[kind]
    assert len(pins[kind]) == 7
    assert all(digest((directory/name).read_bytes()) == pin for name,pin in pins[kind].items())
for name, pin in pins['supplied_context_sha256'].items():
    assert digest((root/'resume-context/resume-start-r4'/name).read_bytes()) == pin
flow = root/'resume-context/resume-start-r4/OWNER-FLOW-CONTROLS-R2.py'
assert flow.read_bytes() == old(flow)
assert digest(flow.read_bytes()) == '369c120b901b1ee3faeb642d6d498ef2ae0e5b98904c44d0b1a9c64c3a51e062'
driver = (q/'root_fixture_plan.py').read_text()
previous_driver = old(q/'root_fixture_plan.py').decode()
assert previous_driver[previous_driver.index('def fresh_overlays('):] == driver[driver.index('def fresh_overlays('):]
coordinator = (root/'root_resume_fixture_coordinator.py').read_text()
previous_coordinator = old(root/'root_resume_fixture_coordinator.py').decode()
assert previous_coordinator.replace('with d.held_inventory() as before:',
    'with d.held_inventory(before_fixture=True) as before:') == coordinator
test = (q/'test_root_fixture_isolation.py').read_text()
previous_test = old(q/'test_root_fixture_isolation.py').decode()
old_tree, new_tree = ast.parse(previous_test), ast.parse(test)
new_classes = {c.name:c for c in new_tree.body if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef)}
old_count = 0
for cls in old_tree.body:
    if not isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef):
        continue
    old_count += sum(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_') for n in cls.body)
    original = ast.get_source_segment(previous_test, cls)
    current = ast.get_source_segment(test, new_classes[cls.name])

        original = original.replace('def inventory():', 'def inventory(*, before_fixture=False):').replace(

            "                label = 'before' if not events else 'after'\n                self.assertEqual(before_fixture, label == 'before')\n")
    assert original == current, cls.name
assert old_count == 28
test_first = test.replace('def inventory(*, before_fixture=False):', 'def inventory():').replace(

assert digest(test_first.encode()) == '671b4216a3c129a7123a9cfff01728272457c95d421fff8be12ad50bbea40572'
for key,path in updated.items():

), indent=2))
